$comment: The token file for the mobile-app pack, and the single source of truth for
every colour and measurement in an app built from it.
It is JSON rather than a stylesheet because the same screen gets built in
SwiftUI, Compose, React Native and sometimes CSS, and a palette that lives
in one of those four is a palette the other three retype. Generate the
platform file from this; assets/tokens.css shows the shape for the web.
TO REBRAND: change `color.accent` and `color.accentPressed`, both values
of each, then `color.accentOnInverse`, which is the accent's two values
the other way round. Nothing else moves. Never ship an accent with one
value - it will disappear against one of the two themes, and dark mode is
Sizes are in pt. Treat 1pt = 1dp = 1 React Native unit = 1 Flutter logical
pixel. Text sizes map to sp on Android, so they scale with the user's font
setting; spacing maps to dp, so it does not.

$comment-brindle: Everything from here to the end of `color` was added for the Brindle demo.
Above it is the pack's file with its values re-chosen for the brand: an
ink, a teal and a cream. The teal (`brand`) is 2.2:1 on white, so it is
spent on fills and graphics only - text and selection get `accentText`
and `accentRing`, which are the same hue darkened until they pass.

text.$comment: Map these onto the platform's own text styles rather than setting sizes directly - that is what makes the user's font-size setting work.

space.$comment: 4pt base. A value not in this set is the beginning of drift.

font.$comment: Added for the Brindle demo. League Spartan, vendored in fonts/ under the OFL. It has no tabular figures, so figures in a column are set in fixed-width cells - see .fig in app.css.

target.$comment: core/09-input.md sets the 24pt floor; this pack raises it. Measured on the hit area, which is padding, not on the drawn icon.

chrome.$comment: Add the runtime safe-area inset to the bar heights. Never hardcode the inset.

motion.$comment: Within core/04-motion.md's bands, at the fast end. Direction matters more than duration: a push enters from the edge it will return to.
